judged_text: In sync mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo` is a fetch Response rather than an axios response, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` throws a TypeError reading 'error' of undefined. Zoho CRM token refresh crashes whenever credential sharing is enabled, failing Zoho CRM calendar sync at the first expired token.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sync mode `zohoCrmTokenInfo` is a fetch Response rather than an axios response, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` throws a TypeError reading 'error' of undefined. Zoho CRM token refresh crashes whenever credential sharing is enabled, failing Zoho CRM calendar sync at the first expired token.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it returns a `fetch(...)` Response object. In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then code does `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. A `fetch` Response has no `.data`, so in sync mode this will throw (cannot read properties of undefined) and break Zoho CRM token refresh when credential sharing is enabled.
